title: Product-projection models and normalized supported trace sources
statement: For a scheme Y, the first projective-line model of P1(Y)×Y P1(Y) is the inverse of the canonical projective-space base-change pullback isomorphism, flipped so its structure morphism is the first projection. The second model composes factor symmetry with the first. IsIntegration(R,a,t,δ) is a≫R(δ)≫t=id. For prime l, supportedSourceNormalization fixes the inverse ordinary supported-source comparison after scalar forgetting as precisely lowerStarComp along Δ,f, followed by the equality Δ≫f=id and lowerStarId. SupportedSource is the NormalizedSource record with this predicate, actual completed coefficient unit, actual completed supported source and the specified right derived direct image. These are the existing definitions moved verbatim to an importable interface module.
